```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)


#install.packages("tidyverse")
#install.packages("ez")
#install.packages("readxl")
#install.packages("car")
#install.packages("emmeans")
#install.packages("Hmisc")
#install.packages("effectsize", repos = "https://easystats.r-universe.dev/")
#install.packages("afex")
#install.packages("knitr")


library(tidyverse)
library(ez)
library(readxl)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(Hmisc)
library(effectsize)
library(afex)
library(knitr)

survivor<-read_excel("./all40.xlsx")

#data file that includes participants from all 40 seasons
survivor<- survivor %>%
  mutate(eff_men = case_when(gender == "f" ~ -.5,
                             gender == "m" ~ .5),
         eff_white = case_when(white == "yes" ~ .5,
                             gender == "no" ~ -.5),
         makemerge1y = case_when(makemerge2 == "a_yes" ~ 1,
                                makemerge2 == "b_no" ~0,),
         makemerge0y = case_when(makemerge2 == "a_yes" ~ 0,
                                makemerge2 == "b_no" ~1,),
         bootfirsttribe1y = case_when(bootfirsttribe == "a_ye" ~1,
                                      bootfirsttribe == "b_no" ~0),
         bootfirst1y = case_when(bootfirst == "a_ye" ~1,
                                      bootfirst == "b_no" ~0),
         finaltribal1y = case_when(finaltribal == "a_y" ~ 1,
                                   finaltribal == "b_n" ~0),
         winner1y = case_when(winner == "a_yes" ~ 1,
                              winner == "b_no"~ 0))


#dataset for the analyses that includes participants from all 40 seasons
all40<-survivor


#dataset for analyses that examines tribes not divided bby race or gender
noracegenderedtribes<-survivor%>%
  filter(tribeoneracee == "n")%>%
  filter(seasnum !=13)%>%
  filter(tribesbygender == "n")

#dataset for analyses that examines tribes not divided by race
noracetribes<-survivor%>%
  filter(tribeoneracee == "n")%>%
  filter(seasnum !=13)


survivor %>% group_by(tribeoneracee) %>% tally()

#dataset that indicates the number of contestants on seasons where contestants are not divided by race
count.racetribe <- noracetribes%>%
  group_by(seasnum, tribeoneracee) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

#dataset for analyses that examines tribes not divided by gender
nogenderedtribes<-survivor%>%
  filter(tribesbygender == "n")

#dataset that indicates the number of contestants on seasons where contestants are not divided by gender
      count.gendtribe <- nogenderedtribes%>%
        group_by(seasnum, tribesbygender) %>%
        summarise(n = n())

#dataset of contestants who made the merge
makemerge<-survivor%>%
  filter(makemerge == "y")

#dataset of contestants who were finalists
onlyinfinal<-survivor%>%
  filter(finalvote == "ru" | finalvote == "w")

#dataset of contestants who were finalists in which there was at least 1 man and 1 woman
finalbygender<-onlyinfinal%>%
  filter(seasnum !=4 & 
           seasnum !=5 & 
           seasnum !=7 &
           seasnum !=11 &
           seasnum !=16 &
           seasnum !=18 &
           seasnum !=21 &
           seasnum !=24 &
           seasnum !=28 &
           seasnum !=29 )

#dataset of contestants who were finalists in which there was at least 1 white and 1 non-white contestant
finalbyrace<-onlyinfinal%>%
  filter(seasnum !=1 & 
           seasnum !=2 & 
           seasnum !=3 &
           seasnum !=5 &
           seasnum !=6 &
           seasnum !=8 &
           seasnum !=9 &
           seasnum !=10 &
           seasnum !=11 &
           seasnum !=12 &
           seasnum !=13 & 
           seasnum !=14 & 
           seasnum !=15 &
           seasnum !=16 &
           seasnum !=18 &
           seasnum !=19 &
           seasnum !=20 &
           seasnum !=25 &
           seasnum !=26 &
           seasnum !=33 &
           seasnum !=34 &
           seasnum !=35)

#dataset for survival analysis--see SAS code for the analysis reported in paper
survival.analysis<-survivor%>%
  filter(status == 1)

#dataset that represents proportion of votes to win that finalists received for all seasons--results in supplemental analysis
propfinalvotes<-survivor%>%
  filter(!is.na(propfinvotes))

#dataset that represents proportion of votes to win that finalists received among seasons that had at least 1 man and 1 woman as a finalist--results in supplemental analysis
prop.gender<-finalbygender%>%
  filter(!is.na(propfinvotes))

#dataset that represents proportion of votes to win that finalists received among seasons that had at least 1 white and 1 nonwhite contestant as a finalist--results in supplemental analysis
prop.race<-finalbyrace%>%
  filter(!is.na(propfinvotes))

#dataset for the analysis examining physical strength as an alternative explanation
phys_strong<-survivor%>%
  filter(!is.na(phys_strong))

#dataset for the analysis examining intelligence as an alternative explanation
smart_intel<-survivor%>%
  filter(!is.na(smart_intel))

#dataset for examining individual immunity wins among contestants who make it to the merge
indivimmunitywins.dat<-makemerge%>%
  filter(!is.na(indivimmunitywins))

#dataset for the correlations between each DV and the trait ratings for each contestant--results in supplemental analysis and main document
correlations<-survivor%>%
  select(trustworthy:mischievous, boot_sp:win_sp)

#dataset for the analysis examining hardworking as an alternative explanation
hardworking<-survivor%>%
  filter(!is.na(hardworking))


#dataset of tribes who have women in them
bootwomen<-survivor%>%
  filter(percentwomen > 0 &
         percentwomen < 100)


#how to get the R citation for citing it within papers
#citation("pkgname")

version$version.string
citation()
```

```{r PRIMARY ANALYSIS, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#ANALYSIS FOR BEING THE FIRST VOTED OUT OF THE TRIBE

#examining contestants from all 40 seasons
bootfirstlogit.all <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(bootfirstlogit.all )
Anova(bootfirstlogit.all , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(bootfirstlogit.all ), confint(bootfirstlogit.all )))

#calculating the number of people on tribes that consist of only people from the same race
survivor %>% group_by(tribeoneracee) %>% tally()

#calculating the number of tribes that consist of people from the same race
tribesonerace<-survivor %>% group_by(startingtribe,tribeoneracee) %>% tally()
tribesonerace%>% group_by(tribeoneracee) %>% tally()



#examining contestants who were on racially diverse tribes

bootfirstlogit.race <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ e_white, 
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          data=noracetribes)
        
summary(bootfirstlogit.race )
Anova(bootfirstlogit.race, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(bootfirstlogit.race), confint(bootfirstlogit.race )))


#calculating the number of people on tribes that consist of only people from the same gender
survivor %>% group_by(tribesbygender) %>% tally()

#calculating the number of tribes that consist of only people from the same gender
tribesonegender<-survivor %>% group_by(startingtribe,tribesbygender) %>% tally()
tribesonegender%>% group_by(tribesbygender) %>% tally()



#examining contestants who were on gender diverse tribes

bootfirstlogit.gender <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ e_gender ,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          data=nogenderedtribes)
        
summary(bootfirstlogit.gender )
Anova(bootfirstlogit.gender, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(bootfirstlogit.gender),confint(bootfirstlogit.gender)))


#MAKING THE MERGE
        
#examining contestants from all 40 seasons
merge.all <- glm(makemerge1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(merge.all)
Anova(merge.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(merge.all), confint(merge.all)))


#examining contestants who were on racially diverse tribes
merge.norace <- glm(makemerge1y ~ e_white, 
                    family=binomial(link='logit'),
                    data=noracetribes)
  
summary(merge.norace)
Anova(merge.norace, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(merge.norace), confint(merge.norace)))

#examining contestants who were on gender diverse tribes
merge.nogender <- glm(makemerge1y ~ e_gender, 
                    family=binomial(link='logit'),
                    data=nogenderedtribes)
  
summary(merge.nogender)
Anova(merge.nogender, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(merge.nogender), confint(merge.nogender)))

  

#BEING A FINALIST

#examining contestants from all 40 seasons
finalist.all <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(finalist.all)
Anova(finalist.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalist.all), confint(finalist.all)))



#examining racial and gender bias among contestants who made the merge
finalist.merge <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=makemerge)

summary(finalist.merge)
Anova(finalist.merge, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalist.merge), confint(finalist.merge)))


#examining gender without race among people who made the merge
finalist.merge <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ e_gender, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=makemerge)

summary(finalist.merge)
Anova(finalist.merge, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalist.merge), confint(finalist.merge)))


#examining race without gender among people who made the merge
finalist.merge <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=makemerge)

summary(finalist.merge)
Anova(finalist.merge, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalist.merge), confint(finalist.merge)))


#winning

#all 40
winning.all <- glm(winner1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(winning.all)
Anova(winning.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(winning.all), confint(winning.all)))



#examining winning among gender diverse sets of finalists

winning.gender <- glm(winner1y ~ e_gender, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=finalbygender)

summary(winning.gender )
Anova(winning.gender , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(winning.gender ), confint(winning.gender )))

#examining winning among racially diverse sets of finalists

winning.race <- glm(winner1y ~ e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=finalbyrace)

summary(winning.race )
Anova(winning.race , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(winning.race ), confint(winning.race )))




```

```{r ANALYSIS FOR RULING OUT ALTERNATIVE EXPLANATIONS, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#PHYSICAL STRENGTH

phys_strong.analysis<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "phys_strong", phys_strong, between =c("gender", "white"), type=3)

print(phys_strong.analysis)
summary(phys_strong.analysis)
effectsize(phys_strong.analysis)
emmeans(phys_strong.analysis, ~gender*white)
emmeans(phys_strong.analysis, ~gender)
emmeans(phys_strong.analysis, ~white)
cohens_d(phys_strong ~ gender, data = phys_strong)
cohens_d(phys_strong ~ white, data = phys_strong)

#cell means and standard deviations
strong1 <- group_by(phys_strong, gender)
summarise(strong1, mean=mean(phys_strong), sd=sd(phys_strong))

strong2 <- group_by(phys_strong, white)
summarise(strong2, mean=mean(phys_strong), sd=sd(phys_strong))


phys_strong.means= ezStats(data=phys_strong
	, dv=phys_strong
	, wid = id
	, between = .(gender, white)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(phys_strong.means)

phys_strong.gender.mns= ezStats(data=phys_strong
	, dv=phys_strong
	, wid = id
	, between = .(gender)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(phys_strong.gender.mns)

phys_strong.race.mns= ezStats(data=phys_strong
	, dv=phys_strong
	, wid = id
	, between = .(white)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(phys_strong.race.mns)





#CORRELATIONS BETWEEN PHYS STRONG AND EACH DV

allcorrs <- rcorr(as.matrix(correlations),type="spearman")
allcorrs

# Extract the correlation coefficients
allcorrs$r
# Extract p-values
allcorrs$P

#Is Physical strength a mediator analysis
phys_strength.med <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ e_white*e_gender+phys_strong, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=all40)

summary(phys_strength.med)
Anova(phys_strength.med , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(phys_strength.med ), confint(phys_strength.med )))


#INTELLIGENCE


smart.analysis<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "smart_intel", smart_intel, between =c("gender", "white"), type=3)

print(smart.analysis)
summary(smart.analysis)
effectsize(smart.analysis)
emmeans(smart.analysis, ~gender*white)
emmeans(smart.analysis, ~gender)
emmeans(smart.analysis, ~white)
cohens_d(smart_intel ~ gender, data = smart_intel)
cohens_d(smart_intel ~ white, data = smart_intel)

#cell means and standard deviations
smart1 <- group_by(smart_intel, gender)
summarise(smart1, mean=mean(smart_intel), sd=sd(smart_intel))

smart2 <- group_by(smart_intel, white)
summarise(smart2, mean=mean(smart_intel), sd=sd(smart_intel))


smart.means= ezStats(data=smart_intel
	, dv=smart_intel
	, wid = id
	, between = .(gender, white)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(smart.means)

smart.gender= ezStats(data=smart_intel
	, dv=smart_intel
	, wid = id
	, between = .(gender)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(smart.gender)

smart.race= ezStats(data=smart_intel
	, dv=smart_intel
	, wid = id
	, between = .(white)
	, type = 3
	, reverse_diff = TRUE
, check_args = TRUE)

print(smart.race)


#CORRELATIONS BETWEEN intelligence AND EACH DV

allcorrs <- rcorr(as.matrix(correlations),type="spearman")
allcorrs

# Extract the correlation coefficients
allcorrs$r
# Extract p-values
allcorrs$P
```

```{r supplemental analyses--The Number of Votes Received to Win the Game, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

#proportion of final votes for all contestants
prop.ana<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "propfinvotes", propfinalvotes, between =c("gender", "white"), type=3)

print(prop.ana)
summary(prop.ana)
effectsize(prop.ana)
emmeans(prop.ana, ~gender*white)
cohens_d(propfinvotes ~ gender, data = propfinalvotes)
cohens_d(propfinvotes ~ white, data = propfinalvotes)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp1 <- group_by(propfinalvotes, gender)
summarise(grp1, mean=mean(propfinvotes), sd=sd(propfinvotes))

grp2 <- group_by(propfinalvotes, white)
summarise(grp2, mean=mean(propfinvotes), sd=sd(propfinvotes))


#proportion of final votes received for gender diverse sets of finalists

prop.ana.g<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "propfinvotes", prop.gender, between =c("gender"), type=3)

print(prop.ana.g)
summary(prop.ana.g)
effectsize(prop.ana.g)
emmeans(prop.ana.g, ~gender)
cohens_d(propfinvotes ~ gender, data = prop.gender)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp3 <- group_by(prop.gender, gender)
summarise(grp3, mean=mean(propfinvotes), sd=sd(propfinvotes))


#proportion of final votes received for racially diverse sets of finalists
prop.ana.r<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "propfinvotes", prop.race, between =c("white"), type=3)

print(prop.ana.r)
summary(prop.ana.r)
effectsize(prop.ana.r)
emmeans(prop.ana.r, ~white)
eta_squared(prop.ana.r)
cohens_d(propfinvotes ~ white, data = prop.race)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp4 <- group_by(prop.race, white)
summarise(grp4, mean=mean(propfinvotes), sd=sd(propfinvotes))


```

```{r supplemental analyses--Do White Men have an Advantage in Survivor?, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#primary analysis for whether white men have an advantage in survivor--white men versus everyone else 


#voted out of the tribe first

#contestants from all 40 seasons
whitemanbootfirst.all <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ whiteman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(whitemanbootfirst.all)
Anova(whitemanbootfirst.all , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(whitemanbootfirst.all ), confint(whitemanbootfirst.all )))


#contestants from tribes that are not divided by race or gender
whitemanbootfirst.spec <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ whiteman+notwhitetribe, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=noracegenderedtribes)

summary(whitemanbootfirst.spec)
Anova(whitemanbootfirst.spec , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(whitemanbootfirst.spec ), confint(whitemanbootfirst.spec )))



#MAKING THE MERGE

#contestants from all 40 seasons
mergewhiteman.all <- glm(makemerge1y ~ whiteman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(mergewhiteman.all)
Anova(mergewhiteman.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(mergewhiteman.all), confint(mergewhiteman.all)))


#contestants from tribes not divided by race or gender
mergewhiteman.noracegender <- glm(makemerge1y ~ whiteman+notwhitetribe, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=noracegenderedtribes)

summary(mergewhiteman.noracegender)
Anova(mergewhiteman.noracegender, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(mergewhiteman.noracegender), confint(mergewhiteman.noracegender)))



#BEING A FINALIST

#examining likelihood of being a finalist among contestants from all 40 seasons
finalistwhiteman.all <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ whiteman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(finalistwhiteman.all)
Anova(finalistwhiteman.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalistwhiteman.all), confint(finalistwhiteman.all)))


#analysis among contestants who made the merge

#examining whether individual immunity challange wins varied based on whether a contestants was a white man or not
test<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "indivimmunitywins", indivimmunitywins.dat, between =c("whiteman"), type=3)

print(test)
summary(test)
effectsize(test)
emmeans(test, ~whiteman)
cohens_d(indivimmunitywins ~ whiteman, data = indivimmunitywins.dat)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp <- group_by(indivimmunitywins.dat, whiteman)
summarise(grp, mean=mean(indivimmunitywins), sd=sd(indivimmunitywins))

#examining whether individual immunity challenge wins varies based on whether a person became a finalist or not
test2<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "indivimmunitywins", indivimmunitywins.dat, between =c("finaltribal"), type=3)

print(test2)
summary(test2)
effectsize(test2)
emmeans(test2, ~finaltribal)
cohens_d(indivimmunitywins ~ finaltribal, data = indivimmunitywins.dat)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp2 <- group_by(indivimmunitywins.dat, finaltribal)
summarise(grp2, mean=mean(indivimmunitywins), sd=sd(indivimmunitywins))


#finalist analysis only among people who made the merge controlling for individual immunity challenge wins
finalist.merge2 <- glm(finaltribal1y ~ whiteman+indivimmunitywins, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=makemerge)

summary(finalist.merge2)
Anova(finalist.merge2, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(finalist.merge2), confint(finalist.merge2)))


#winning

#examining likelihood of winning among contestants from all 40 seasons
winning.all2 <- glm(winner1y ~ whiteman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(winning.all2)
Anova(winning.all2, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(winning.all2), confint(winning.all2)))


#do immunity challenge wins vary by whether or not someone is an eventual winner?
test3<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "indivimmunitywins", onlyinfinal, between =c("winner"), type=3)

print(test3)
summary(test3)
effectsize(test3)
emmeans(test3, ~winner)
cohens_d(indivimmunitywins ~ winner, data = onlyinfinal)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp3 <- group_by(onlyinfinal, winner)
summarise(grp3, mean=mean(indivimmunitywins), sd=sd(indivimmunitywins))


#examining likelihood of winning among finalists
winning.whiteman <- glm(winner1y ~ whiteman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=onlyinfinal)

summary(winning.whiteman)
Anova(winning.whiteman , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(winning.whiteman ), confint(winning.whiteman )))



#examining proportion of votes received to win among people in the final
test4<-aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "propfinvotes", onlyinfinal, between =c("whiteman"), type=3)

print(test4)
summary(test4)
emmeans(test4, ~whiteman)
cohens_d(propfinvotes ~ whiteman, data = onlyinfinal)

#cell means and standard deviations
grp4 <- group_by(onlyinfinal, whiteman)
summarise(grp4, mean=mean(propfinvotes), sd=sd(propfinvotes))

```

```{r supplemental analyses--Do BIPOC women have an DISAdvantage in Survivor?, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#primary analysis for nonwhitewomen

#examining being the first voted out of the tribe among contestants from all 40 seasons
nwwbootfirst.all <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ nonwhitewoman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(nwwbootfirst.all)
Anova(nwwbootfirst.all , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(nwwbootfirst.all ), confint(nwwbootfirst.all )))


#examining being the first voted out of the tribe among tribes that have race and gender variability (i.e., not divided by race or gender)
nwwbootfirst.spec <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ nonwhitewoman+notwhitetribe, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=noracegenderedtribes)

summary(nwwbootfirst.spec)
Anova(nwwbootfirst.spec , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(nwwbootfirst.spec ), confint(nwwbootfirst.spec )))



#MAKING THE MERGE

#examining likelihood of making the merge among contestants from all 40 seasons
mergenww.all <- glm(makemerge1y ~ nonwhitewoman, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(mergenww.all)
Anova(mergenww.all, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(mergenww.all), confint(mergenww.all)))

#examining likelihood of making the merge among contestants from tribes that are not divided by race or gender, controlling for how many non-white people are on the tribe
mergenww.noracegender <- glm(makemerge1y ~ nonwhitewoman+notwhitetribe, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=noracegenderedtribes)
```

```{r Reviewer 1, #4 example analysis included in response, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


#ANALYSIS FOR BEING THE FIRST VOTED OUT OF THE TRIBE

#examining likelihood of being voted out first among contestants from all 40 seasons
#using effects coded variables for race and gender
bootfirstlogit.all <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ e_gender*e_white, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(bootfirstlogit.all )
Anova(bootfirstlogit.all , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(bootfirstlogit.all ), confint(bootfirstlogit.all )))


#creating a factor variable which converts our variables to be coded as 1 or 2, for our two categorical predictors
survivor$gender_f <- as.numeric(factor(survivor$gender))
survivor$white_f <- as.numeric(factor(survivor$white))


#examining likelihood of being voted out first using "factored" variable for gender and race
bootfirstlogit.all2 <- glm(bootfirsttribe1y ~ gender_f*white_f, 
                  family=binomial(link='logit'),
                  data=survivor)

summary(bootfirstlogit.all2 )
Anova(bootfirstlogit.all2 , type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(bootfirstlogit.all2 ), confint(bootfirstlogit.all2 )))




```
